not_verified: LOGIN_FAILED (p3dev-l1, 4 Nov) is not caused in credentials: claim then login by the walk's handle (jadmin-<hex>, device own) answers ok:true with a token through this module's ops map (t53.test.mjs). Cause, other module/script: the control plane relays both answers through answer-envelope's relayAnswer as {ok:true, result:{...}} (control-plane/index.mjs:1041,1101; answer-envelope/index.mjs:317), and bio-plane/scripts/p3dev-walk-setup.mjs op() reads j.ok and j.token at the top level, so the login check fails at HTTP 200 with no reason even on success; its claim check also passes on a store refusal (outer ok:true), so the claim's own answer on the walk was not seen. The screens (screens-entry/setup.mjs:438) unwrap .result. Not run against a live deployment. R27/R63/R73 were already met by tranche's code; no src change, so the new tests cannot fail on revert (a mutation removing the account_id revocation in #accountCleared made the R63 test fail, checked by hand, not committed).

exempt.revert: No source change: R27, R63 and R73 were already met by the code on tranche; the new tests assert each mark's Test line and the walk's claim-then-login shape. A hand mutation (dropping #accountCleared's account_id revocation) failed the R63 test.
